differences: Extension of already-approved C001 additional n3 seeds to the same spare-CPU execution declared by C006. Uses A019 calibrated inference artifacts instead of original A003 artifacts. Sampling, predictions, readout and reporting are fixed before any additional-seed result. Eight-thread CPU arithmetic remains an explicit adaptation; no all-platform equivalence claim.
contrary_evidence: A frozen linear readout may miss nonlinear information; sorted white positions are exchangeable positional ranks, not persistent identities. Reversing actions can preserve net displacement and be weak. Good readout is not good latent geometry or planning. Single-seed episode intervals omit training-seed uncertainty. CPU/GPU arithmetic can differ despite earlier sampled parity.
